packs.label: Merixa Risk Management Formula Glossary v1.0

terms.title: Enterprise Market Exposure Ratio
terms.formula: Market Exposure / Total Risk Exposure
terms.components: Market Exposure: measured exposure; Total Risk Exposure: aggregate exposure base
terms.definition: Enterprise Market Exposure Ratio is computed as Market Exposure / Total Risk Exposure. Inputs: Market Exposure: measured exposure; Total Risk Exposure: aggregate exposure base.
terms.example: Scenario: a practitioner computes “Enterprise Market Exposure Ratio” as Market Exposure / Total Risk Exposure, assembling inputs (Market Exposure: measured exposure; Total Risk Exposure: aggregate exposure base), records the figure with the evidence trail, and confirms the decision the number supports before sign-off.
terms.commonError: Do not treat “Enterprise Market Exposure Ratio” as decision-ready without confirming the formula inputs match the intended measure (Market Exposure: measured exposure; Total Risk Exposure: aggregate exposure base); wrong components misstate the figure.
